title: Gen Agent config
description: User (`~/.config/gen/config.json`) or project (`.gen/config.json`) layer. Only keys listed in FILE_LAYER_KEYS plus hooks/hooksPath/meta are applied. Strings may use `${env:VAR}` and `{file:path}` interpolation where supported.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL or path (metadata; not mapped into settings).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when project Gen was initialized (metadata).

hooks.description: Inline hooks; non-empty lists override the hooks file.

primaryTools.description: Allowlist for primary agent tools; empty = all.

modelRoutedPatch.description: If true (default), GPT-family models get apply_patch; others get write/edit only. false keeps apply_patch for all models.

watcherIgnore.description: Glob/gitignore patterns the FS watcher skips.

webSearchBackend.description: web_search backend. duckduckgo (default, no key); exa/parallel need webSearchApiKey (x-api-key); http uses webSearchHttpUrl + optional key header.

designScreenshotEnabled.description: Allow design_screenshot (optional Playwright + Chromium, not bundled in VSIX).

privacyMode.description: Mask likely secrets in tool cards and busy status.

blockNonLocalUrls.description: Block non-local URLs for web tools.

trustedPlugins.description: Allowlisted npm plugins as exact package@version, optionally followed by #sha256=<declared-bin digest>.

persistAlwaysAllow.description: Persist Always-allow patterns across reloads (workspaceState; default false)

maxContextTokens.description: Estimated context window (tokens); synced with engine n_ctx on overflow

contextOverflowPolicy.description: On context overflow: auto shrink/retry, ask user, or fail immediately

planShellPolicy.description: Shell in Plan mode: ask (always confirm) or deny (hide shell tools). Edits stay blocked.

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Max concurrent agent runs across tabs

tabEvictionPolicy.description: When at maxTabCount: block new tabs, or close oldest idle (not current/busy)

toolOutputModelMaxChars.description: Max chars of each tool result in the model prompt path (default 2000)

localEmbeddingsMode.description: Local offline semantic path: off (remote only) | trigram (default) | vector (feature-hash dense index in vectors.json)

outlineEngine.description: Outline: auto (Tree-sitter wasm -> TS/LSP) | treesitter | lsp | typescript

chunkEngine.description: Chunking: auto (AST Tree-sitter when available) | treesitter | lines

treeSitterLanguages.description: Tree-sitter languages: empty = full set (go/cpp/rust/js-ts/php/python/html/json/yaml/sql/kotlin/swift/dart/css + java/bash); * / all = all available wasm; else ids. Not supported: c_sharp, ruby, scala.

treeSitterUseWorker.description: Parse Tree-sitter in a worker_threads Worker (falls back to in-process on failure)

indexForceContentHash.description: Require explicit content-hash for dir skip (ignore mtime gate)

indexStorageBackend.description: Index storage: json (default) | sqlite sidecar for merkle when fileCount >= indexSqliteMinFiles

indexSqliteMinFiles.description: Min fileCount to persist merkle in SQLite when backend=sqlite

midLoopAutoCompact.description: When near context budget mid-loop, soft-compact api messages once before shrink (default true; rule-based only)

llmAutoCompact.description: Opt-in: after rule-based shrink, run LLM summary on smallModel if still over budget (default false)
